text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Seiun Sky's hard work,
adjustments for the Arima Kinen were carefully underway.
Then, one day...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Um. Would it be okay if we pushed today's training back a bit?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I'm not gonna slack off!
What a nasty joke to make.
choice_data_list: Sorry, sorry! So, what happened next?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, you see,
apparently my grandpa is coming today."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Apparently they want to visit their grandchild and just need a little visiting time—"
Sky!!!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Grandpa!?
Why, it's not time yet, right!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who boisterously walked into the Trainer's office
was Seiun Sky's grandfather.
He was holding a bunch of baskets in his arms.

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa! If I came on time,
you wouldn't introduce me to your Trainer, would you?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guh, I've been found out...!

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you, I'm Sky's grandfather!
Thank you for always taking such good care of my granddaughter!

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa, now that's a good look in your eyes!
Sky's a lucky girl to have you watching over her!
Come on, over here!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
G-Grandpa!
Wait—oof!

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Good girl, Sky, good girl!
You're the best granddaughter in the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky's grandfather pulled her in
and vigorously rubbed her head with all his might...

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, here's a little souvenir!
It's fresh produce from my family's farm, and I made sure to include stuff Sky likes too!

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Well, good luck, Sky!
—Glad to see you're doing well!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: She's like a whirlwind, isn't she?
She's like a whirlwind, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's it, she really is a storm!
Larger-than-life, impatient, and above all, loud.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Besides, they have zero tact.
That's why I didn't want you to meet them...
choice_data_list: But you really love your grandpa, huh?
But you really love your grandpa, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
T-That's enough about Grandpa already!
Let's head to training~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And today, we had visitors even during
training breaks.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Good work, Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I brought some juice
as refreshments~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey both of you~.
Well aren't you polite to come all the way over!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to bug you when you're busy.
You must have a lot on your plate with the Arima Kinen coming up, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm okay!
Because right now, my condition is—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan.
That's just Sei-chan's usual trick~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Tch, couldn't you just let something slip?
Well, whatever~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Do you think you'll be able to get yourself into peak condition over there?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"If I say I'm not ready,
will you go easy on me~...? *puppy dog eyes*"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No~? In that case,
you'll just have to take a clean defeat~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~. As expected of Grass-chan, heartless!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, I believe that if it's Sei-chan,
you'll pull yourself into shape in time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The big stage at the end of the year... I'll do my best so I can go all out against a serious Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for you at Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You two are seriously
expecting way too much from me~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow,
that doesn't sound like a compliment.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, guess I'll get back to training.
Wanna finish up early and eat some food, ya know~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by the encouragement of the old man and her rivals,
it became a day of even greater resolve toward winning the Arima Kinen.
